scope: Original frozen coefficients on four fixed anchors at five sampled points per block; no uniform path guarantee
loss_scope: Reference-panel loss remainders for block moves; not held-out full-model optimizer performance
numerical_scope: 2% Frobenius sensitivity allowance plus asymmetry is diagnostic, not a uniform error certificate
timing_scope: Measurement time includes gradients, HVPs, finite differences and losses; not native optimizer throughput
